qualification: N10.3/#397 single-variable follow-up to #396: reduce only the EGO max_velocity_m_s from 0.8 to 0.4 m/s per axis to test whether lower commanded motion reduces the measured PX4/EGO tracking discrepancy and supports positive route-clearance budget. This is an EGO planner parameter, not a runtime speed guard; actual EGO/PX4 speeds remain observation-only.
rationale: #396 held the same 16 m route and obstacle scenario at max_velocity=0.8 m/s, while same-domain PX4 setpoint-to-local-position error P95 was 0.665 m and route EGO tracking P95 was 0.707 m. Test only max_velocity=0.4 m/s; preserve acceleration, horizon, inflation, spawn, target, native dwell, collision policy, obstacle timing/geometry, observers, and every flight decision. Compare actual EGO/PX4 speed, tracking error, route completion, and clearance. This candidate does not add a runtime speed cap or acceptance gate.
